description: Main source file for Playwright test framework, setting up fixtures, utilities, and test environment configuration.

classes.name: SnapshotRecorder

classes.name: ArtifactsRecorder
classes.description: Manages artifacts like screenshots and traces for test contexts.

methods.description: Normalizes various video mode inputs to a standard VideoMode string.

methods.description: Determines if video should be captured based on mode and test info.

methods.name: attachConnectedHeaderIfNeeded
methods.description: Attaches headers from connected browser to test info attachments.

methods.description: Resolves file paths relative to test config file.
